title: Improve Inductor generated kernel names: important pieces like flex attention backward not included
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

I recently had some people puzzling over why `triton_tem_fused__fused_rms_norm__to_copy_mul_split_with_sizes_transpose_view_zeros_26` was so slow. It turns out, this kernel also includes the flex_attention_backward kernel! So for some reason, flex attention isn't showing in the name; but it really should.

FB internal, look at: https://www.internalfb.com/phabricator/paste/view/P2036935804 (inductor output code) and https://www.internalfb.com/phabricator/paste/view/P2036936218 (dynamo)

### Versions

main
